FacetEvidenceReceipt.description:
One required NeedFacet's closure against exact L0 evidence.

Computed once from the selected retrieval candidates and reused by route
stop reasons, support diagnostics and the package gap report, so a route
can never claim ``exact_satisfied`` for a facet the package marks as a gap.

RelationFacetBinding.description:
One ordered relation triple that can close a relation facet.

``RetrievalUnit.entity_ids`` preserves the canonical relation direction
(subject first, object second).  Keeping that direction in the completion
contract prevents an anchor for the inverse edge, or an edge that merely
shares one endpoint, from satisfying an explicit Planner relation.
